song.title: You Are My Vision
song.lyrics:
[V1] .C You are my vision, O King of my heart .G F G Nothing else satisfies, only You Lord .F Am C/E F G You're my best thought by day or by night .C Am F G C Waking or sleeping, Your presence my light
[V2] .C You are my wisdom, You are my true word .G F G I ever with You, and You with me Lord .F Am C/E F G You're my great Father and I'm your true child .C Am F G C You dwell inside me, together we're one
[V3] .C You are my battle-shield, sword for the fight .G F G You are my dignity, You're my delight .F Am C/E F C You're my soul's shelter and You're my high tower .C Am F G C Come raise me heavenward, O power of my power
[V4] .C I don't want riches or man's empty praise .G F G You're my inheritance, now and always .F Am C/E F C You and You only, the first in my heart .C Am F G C High King of heaven, my treasure You are
[V5] .C High King of heaven, when victory's won .G F G May I reach heaven's joy O bright Heaven's Son .F Am C/E F C Heart of my own heart whatever befall .C Am F G C Still be my vision, O Ruler of all
